Describe one column of a BC Data Catalogue layer

Source: R/bag_bcdc_cols.R
bag_bcdc_cols.Rd

Checks that a schema.table and column exist in the BC Data Catalogue WMS service and returns the catalogue's own description of that column.

Usage

bag_bcdc_cols(schema_table, column)

Arguments

schema_table

character The object name of the layer, as schema.table — for example "whse_imagery_and_base_maps.gsr_airports_svw". Case is not significant; it is upper-cased before the query.

column

character The column to describe. Case is not significant.

Value

A tibble::tibble with the schema_table as given, the column name, its local R type and the catalogue's column comments. Zero rows when the column does not exist in the layer.

See also

bag_bcdc_index() for the layer lookup this complements.

Other catalogue: bag_bcdc(), bag_bcdc_index(), bag_bcdc_read()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bag_bcdc_cols(
  "whse_imagery_and_base_maps.gsr_airports_svw",
  "airport_name"
)
} # }
